# hush_cloudinary_access_privilege (Resource)

Manage Cloudinary access privileges in the Hush Security platform: the product environment and the role of the keys issued with a `hush_cloudinary_access_credential`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keys with Cloudinary's built-in Editor role in the product1 environment
resource "hush_cloudinary_access_privilege" "example" {
  name        = "cloudinary-product1-editor"
  description = "Upload, edit and delete assets in product1"
  cloud_name  = "product1"
  role_id     = "cld::role::prodenv::editor"
}

# Keys that can only upload, through a role the access manager creates
resource "hush_cloudinary_access_privilege" "upload_only" {
  name       = "cloudinary-product1-upload"
  cloud_name = "product1"
  system_policy_ids = [
    "cld::policy::global::folder_and_asset_management::create_asset",
    "cld::policy::global::upload_presets::manage",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_name` (String) The cloud name of the product environment the keys are created in: 2 to 128 letters, digits or '-', starting with a letter. Cloudinary matches it case-insensitively
- `name` (String) The name of the Cloudinary access privilege

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the Cloudinary access privilege
- `role_id` (String) A Cloudinary built-in product environment role for the keys, by its ID, such as `cld::role::prodenv::editor`. Set exactly one of `role_id` and `system_policy_ids`. Master Admin, Admin, Tech Admin and MediaFlows Admin can manage API keys: a workload given one can create keys that Hush never revokes
- `system_policy_ids` (Set of String) Cloudinary system policies for a role the access manager creates for each privilege version: 1 to 200 `cld::policy::global::...` IDs, as Cloudinary's role catalog names them. Set exactly one of `role_id` and `system_policy_ids`. With `cld::policy::global::api_keys::manage` a workload can create keys that Hush never revokes, and with `cld::policy::global::api_keys::view` it can read every key's secret

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the Cloudinary access privilege
- `type` (String) The type of access privilege
